review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle, with no candidate results used. C explicitly fixes DEC-001=OPT-1 as a hypothetical input, not a human Decision; the empty decision-input fingerprint and humanConfirmed=false are therefore consistent with ready status. Only the selected branch is required. This does not waive the decisions-stage block required for an unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, exact writable binding scope, and required evidence stages agree with the original specification. The supplied implementation, declaration, and package configuration support index.js and index.d.ts as maintained owners and test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression scopes, without requiring gratuitous edits or release-configuration changes. TASK-VERIFY is independently assigned and specified to depend on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both relationships covering all required acceptance criteria. The allowed implementer and verifier have active trusted claims for the relevant contract, state, data, async, consumer, JavaScript, TypeScript, and automation capabilities; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending security.authorization claims are not needed for this bounded feature. The configured separate active reviewer satisfies the supplied non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the provenance explains the distinct original-PRD, saved-PRD, manifest, and evaluation-source digest domains. The original specification's preparation-time null releaseInput and remaining-work fields are superseded for this review by the supplied frozen preview and Gold release inputs. I rely on the Service's stated mechanical bindings; I did not recompute digests, execute code, attest human decisions, or treat planning readiness as execution approval.
